description: This file defines a set of React functional components for a UI card, including Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, and CardFooter. It also imports a utility function 'cn' for className handling.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: Main container component for the card with styling and customizable className.

methods.name: CardHeader
methods.description: Component for the header section of the card, with specific styling and slot data.

methods.name: CardTitle
methods.description: Component for the card's title area, styled as a heading.

methods.name: CardDescription
methods.description: Component for descriptive text within the card, styled as muted foreground text.

methods.name: CardAction
methods.description: Component for action elements aligned within the card, with specific grid styling.

methods.name: CardContent
methods.description: Component for the main content area of the card, with padding and last-child styling.

methods.name: CardFooter
methods.description: Component for footer section of the card, with flex layout and spacing.
